## Pull Request Checklist

### Description
*Please describe the code or theory changes introduced by this PR, including why they were made.*

### 🚀 Scientific & Experimental Impact
- **Affected Experiments**: [e.g., Run ID or benchmark metrics affected]
- **Related Theorem / Section**: [e.g., Section 3, Theorem 1 Brier Score]
- **Risk Level**: [Low / Medium / High]

### ⚙️ Code Quality & Tests
- [ ] Have I updated the mathematical notation in `docs/NOTATION.md` if any new variables were introduced?
- [ ] Have I logged the changes in `CHANGELOG.md`?
- [ ] Do all unit tests run and pass successfully?
- [ ] Have I run the `GEMINI.md` post-task checklist before submitting?

---
*For PI review only. Ensure all checklist boxes are ticked before merging into `main`.*
